description: FavoriteStore is a lightweight in-memory persistence class implemented using Android's SharedPreferences. It manages storage and retrieval of favorite recipes, maintaining a list of FavoriteRecipe objects, with methods to add, remove, and access favorites. It also ensures singleton access via getInstance method.

classes.name: FavoriteStore
classes.description: A singleton class that provides in-memory persistence for favorite recipes using SharedPreferences, exposing methods for adding, removing, and querying favorites.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FavoriteStore, creating it if necessary, synchronized for thread safety.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all favorite recipes.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe with the given ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new FavoriteRecipe to the favorites list, updating LiveData and SharedPreferences.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a FavoriteRecipe from the list based on its ID, updating LiveData and SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readFromPrefs
methods.description: Reads the list of favorite recipes from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: writeToPrefs
methods.description: Writes the current list of favorites to SharedPreferences.
